// Generated by the verify-ui Gradle plugin. Do not edit: it is rewritten on every build.
package verifyui.runtime

import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsActions
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsNode
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsProperties
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.getOrNull
import androidx.compose.ui.text.TextLayoutResult

/**
 * Serialises the unmerged semantics tree to JSON (all geometry in dp).
 * This is the raw input for the rule-based checks: bounds, clipping,
 * labels, roles, click actions and text overflow per node.
 */
object SemanticsDump {

    fun toJson(root: SemanticsNode, meta: Map<String, Any>): String {
        val density = root.layoutInfo.density.density
        val nodes = mutableListOf<String>()
        fun visit(n: SemanticsNode, parentId: Int?) {
            nodes += node(n, parentId, density)
            n.children.forEach { visit(it, n.id) }
        }
        visit(root, null)
        val metaJson = meta.entries.joinToString(",") { "${q(it.key)}:${value(it.value)}" }
        return "{\"meta\":{$metaJson,\"density\":$density},\"nodes\":[\n" + nodes.joinToString(",\n") + "\n]}\n"
    }

    private fun node(n: SemanticsNode, parentId: Int?, d: Float): String {
        val c = n.config
        val b = n.boundsInRoot
        val pos = n.positionInRoot
        val f = mutableListOf<String>()
        f += "\"id\":${n.id}"
        f += "\"parent\":${parentId ?: "null"}"
        f += "\"bounds\":${rect(b.left, b.top, b.right, b.bottom, d)}"
        f += "\"unclipped\":${rect(pos.x, pos.y, pos.x + n.size.width, pos.y + n.size.height, d)}"
        f += "\"layout\":[${dp(n.layoutInfo.width.toFloat(), d)},${dp(n.layoutInfo.height.toFloat(), d)}]"
        c.getOrNull(SemanticsProperties.Text)?.let { t -> f += "\"text\":${q(t.joinToString(" ") { it.text })}" }
        c.getOrNull(SemanticsProperties.ContentDescription)?.let { f += "\"contentDescription\":${q(it.joinToString(" "))}" }
        c.getOrNull(SemanticsProperties.Role)?.let { f += "\"role\":${q(it.toString())}" }
        c.getOrNull(SemanticsProperties.ToggleableState)?.let { f += "\"toggleState\":${q(it.name)}" }
        c.getOrNull(SemanticsProperties.TestTag)?.let { f += "\"testTag\":${q(it)}" }
        if (c.contains(SemanticsActions.OnClick)) f += "\"clickable\":true"
        if (c.isMergingSemanticsOfDescendants) f += "\"mergesDescendants\":true"
        c.getOrNull(SemanticsActions.GetTextLayoutResult)?.action?.let { getLayout ->
            val results = mutableListOf<TextLayoutResult>()
            if (getLayout(results) && results.isNotEmpty()) {
                val r = results.first()
                val ellipsized = (0 until r.lineCount).any { r.isLineEllipsized(it) }
                // hasVisualOverflow is unreliable under Robolectric (true for most single-line text),
                // so record geometry instead: what the text needs vs. what it was given.
                val neededW = (0 until r.lineCount).maxOfOrNull { r.getLineRight(it) } ?: 0f
                val neededH = r.multiParagraph.height
                f += "\"textLayout\":{\"lines\":${r.lineCount},\"ellipsized\":$ellipsized," +
                    "\"needed\":[${dp(neededW, d)},${dp(neededH, d)}]," +
                    "\"given\":[${dp(r.size.width.toFloat(), d)},${dp(r.size.height.toFloat(), d)}]}"
            }
        }
        return "  {" + f.joinToString(",") + "}"
    }

    private fun rect(l: Float, t: Float, r: Float, b: Float, d: Float) =
        "[${dp(l, d)},${dp(t, d)},${dp(r, d)},${dp(b, d)}]"

    private fun dp(px: Float, d: Float) = Math.round(px / d * 10f) / 10f

    private fun value(v: Any): String = when (v) {
        is Number, is Boolean -> v.toString()
        else -> q(v.toString())
    }

    private fun q(s: String): String = buildString {
        append('"')
        s.forEach {
            when (it) {
                '"' -> append("\\\"")
                '\\' -> append("\\\\")
                '\n' -> append("\\n")
                else -> if (it < ' ') append(String.format("\\u%04x", it.code)) else append(it)
            }
        }
        append('"')
    }
}
